=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:_inject_token_into_url at lines 3040-3052; _resolve_origin_url at lines 3077-3083 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Per-command `http.extraHeader` authentication was replaced with GH_TOKEN embedded in HTTPS git URLs.
  WHY: The token is exposed in process arguments, temporary `.git/config`, git diagnostics, and `MemoryGitError`; `_resolve_origin_url` also ignores GH_PAT.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:_memory_force_tick_remote_url at line 585; memory_ensure_branch at lines 151 and 180 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Force-tick remotes embed credentials while branch probing and pushing use bare git commands after `_memory_git` was removed.
  WHY: Credentials leak through process arguments, remote configuration, and diagnostics, while `persist-credentials: false` checkouts cannot authenticate branch operations and silently skip memory initialization.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:normalize_path at lines 241-245; emit_context loop at lines 568-685; deleted `is_sensitive_target_path` | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path filtering for `.git`, `.env`, `.ssh`, `.aws`, `.docker`, `.gitconfig`, `.git-credentials`, `.gitmodules`, `.netrc`, `.npmrc`, and `.pypirc` was removed.
  WHY: Untrusted paths can resolve to sensitive files and send credentials or repository configuration into model-visible context.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:deleted `MAX_TARGET_PATHS = 256` / `MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES = 1024`; unbounded `for rel in paths:` loop at line 568 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The 256-path and 1024-byte per-path limits were removed.
  WHY: An untrusted path list can cause unbounded filesystem work and marker output, inflating prompts; severity disagreement: qwen reports critical while mistral and moonshot report high.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:deleted `review_blocked_*` helper family, lines 735-972 or former ~972-1378 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The review-blocked approval and successor helper family was deleted while `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh` and `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` still invoke it.
  WHY: Human-approved terminal review-blocked actions always take unavailable-helper or fail-closed branches and cannot complete.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:deleted `git_with_github_auth`; scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2014 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The unguarded judge-fix push still calls the deleted `git_with_github_auth`.
  WHY: The `[judge-fix]` commit is not pushed and review-blocked recovery remains blocked.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:_gh_pr_with_all_comments_rest at lines 766-773; GraphQL projection at lines 903-924 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `id`, `author_id`, `author_type`, and `author_association` were removed from REST and GraphQL comment payloads.
  WHY: Producer identity and maintainer-role checks cannot match trusted comments, even if the deleted helpers are restored.

- scripts/write_codex_config.sh:argument parser lines 95-114; hardcoded `base_url` at line 261 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--provider-base-url` was removed although callers still pass it, and the emitted base URL is hardcoded to `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`.
  WHY: Brokered config generation exits 2 before Codex starts, and any tolerated invocation bypasses the broker loopback and its policy enforcement.

- scripts/model_provider_broker.py:BrokerState.reserve_request lines 178-192 and `do_POST` lines 268-317 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Output-token reservations are not refunded, and requests without an explicit limit reserve the full 16384-token default.
  WHY: Four default reservations exhaust the 65536-token session budget and the fifth request returns HTTP 429 during normal multi-turn phases.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:emit_context at lines 558-564 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `max_bytes=0` emits a header and disabled marker instead of returning an empty string.
  WHY: The documented targeted-context kill switch is broken and its contract tests fail; severity disagreement: mistral, moonshot, and qwen report high while the other reviewers report critical.

- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py:imports at lines 30 and 37; usages at lines 714-716 and 776-781 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The test module imports deleted `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` and `is_sensitive_target_path`.
  WHY: ImportError occurs during collection, so the suite cannot run.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:emit_context header/summary lines 558-564, 687-713; inline path lines 677-685 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: Structural headers, summaries, markers, and wrappers are not charged against `max_bytes`.
  WHY: Targeted context can exceed the documented hard byte limit.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:lines 569-580 and 677 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: OSError guards around path resolution, stat, and file reads were removed.
  WHY: Concurrent deletion, permission changes, or symlink races can abort the complete context build instead of omitting one entry.

- scripts/codex_helpers.sh:line 165 or lines 164-172 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: CSV model entries are not trimmed and empty entries are not filtered before regex validation.
  WHY: Spaces or a trailing comma make broker startup fail closed; minimax reports critical while deepseek reports high.

- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:lines 893-920 and 1043-1080 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: Reusable workflow validation hardcodes `shubhodeep1/coding-workflows` and removes fail-open checkout behavior.
  WHY: Forks or non-source reusable callers fail validation and abort the autofix flow.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:lines 59-68 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The HEAD-tree predicate was replaced with index-based `git ls-files --error-unmatch`, and the restore command lost `--staged`.
  WHY: Staged-only or unmerged-index states can restore the wrong tree or leave inconsistent staged/unstaged state; severity disagreement: deepseek reports high while mistral reports low.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:lines 8440-8471 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: Conflict healing paginates the entire PR comment history on every five-minute poll tick without caching or a comment-count cap.
  WHY: Busy PRs can multiply GitHub API calls and parsing work and risk secondary rate limits; moonshot explicitly reports this is accepted by design and does not flag it.

- scripts/review_conflict_actuate.sh:lines 39-82 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: Selector rc=2 diagnostics are hidden by the actuator's trap.
  WHY: Invalid payload or keyring failures halt the workflow without structured warnings for operators.

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:line 100 (`patch_diagnose_reasoning_into_config` body) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `local cfg=...` line is tab-indented unlike the surrounding function body.
  WHY: Shellcheck with SC-indent can fail and prevent the diagnose path from running.
